acceptance_criteria: Schedule and observation intent is ordered by explicit simulation time, tick, or declared order.
The semantic plan identity is unchanged when only a run identifier or wall-clock observation differs.
Equivalent YAML/JSON encodings and input permutations produce an equal semantic plan identity.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The compiler shall order schedule and observation intent by explicit simulation time, tick, or declared order, and shall compute the canonical semantic plan identity from declared content only, excluding run identifiers and wall-clock observations.
title: Simulation time ordering and canonical semantic identity
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
